difficulty_reason: Delta must be a closed immersion; the four pieces U x_Y U, U x_Y V, V x_Y U, V x_Y V form an etale covering of X x_Y X, and the pullbacks of Delta along them are exactly U, U x_X V, V x_X U, V; the hypotheses (both parts separated, the intersection map closed) say precisely that Delta is closed on each piece, hence a closed immersion by etale descent.
